name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. This keeps the interface readable in low light and reduces eye strain, which matters for long screentime. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode for daylight readability, but the toggle makes it reversible. This aligns with Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark interface, ensuring consistency with proven UX patterns.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode by default still ignores users who need light mode for daylight readability—especially those with visual impairments or migraines triggered by glare. A better alternative is a system that remembers the user’s last mode choice and defaults to it, with a visible toggle. Settle it by testing both approaches with users who report glare sensitivity and measuring task completion time in bright vs. low light.

name: Facet
text:
Implement a system that remembers the user’s last mode choice and defaults to it, paired with a visible toggle for quick switching. This approach accommodates all users, addressing the needs of both dark mode and light mode proponents without compromising visibility or comfort. The trade-off is the increased initial complexity in design, but the overall user satisfaction and accessibility outweigh this concern, ensuring everyone can enjoy and utilize the interface effectively.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Remembering last mode choice still fails users who switch modes mid-session—like stepping outside after dark work—because the system defaults to a stale preference. A better alternative is a lightweight, persistent toggle that stays visible, paired with a one-click "auto" option that detects ambient light. Settle it by testing task completion time in both glare and low-light conditions.

name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Default to a persistent, high-contrast dark theme in EXCAVA with a visible, always-on toggle that remembers the last mode choice and includes a one-click "auto" option detecting ambient light—delivered by visualization-w1 by EOD.
